basis: Generic problem-to-log routing validated by unit fixtures
File purposes remain heuristic unless source_reference contains a stable public URL to a specific source revision

directories.LogDump: Core runtime logs (primary entry for most issues)
directories.OSDump: System snapshots and recent OS/BIOS serial or console recordings
directories.SpLogDump: Version metadata; exact contents remain platform-specific
directories.BMALogDump: Observed section without a reliable cross-product definition; keep contents opaque unless a product-specific source is supplied
directories.3rdDump: Third-party service artifacts; observed contents may include Nginx text logs and configuration, but meanings vary by product
directories.CoreDump: Crash artifacts or nested core archives; keep opaque unless deeper inspection is explicitly authorized
directories.OptBMC: Product-specific configuration or state artifacts; potentially sensitive and not assigned a stable cross-product contract

files.name: framework.log

files.name: observed_logdump_artifact
files.purpose: observed LogDump artifact without a maintained file-specific contract; preserve path and size and do not infer fields from the filename alone

files.name: observed_appdump_artifact
files.purpose: observed AppDump component artifact without a maintained file-specific contract; preserve path and size and do not infer fields from the filename alone

files.name: observed_rtosdump_artifact
files.purpose: observed RTOSDump artifact without a maintained file-specific contract; preserve path and size and do not infer fields from the filename alone

files.name: observed_osdump_artifact
files.purpose: observed OSDump serial, console, image, or archive artifact; keep opaque unless the incident requires bounded inspection

files.name: observed_splogdump_artifact
files.purpose: observed platform-specific or version artifact whose fields vary by product; preserve path and size before interpretation

files.name: observed_bma_artifact
files.purpose: observed BMALogDump artifact; record path and size without assigning cross-product semantics

files.name: observed_device_artifact
files.purpose: observed device-level low-level or register artifact; do not decode binary content without a product-specific contract

files.name: observed_thirdparty_artifact
files.purpose: observed third-party service artifact; inspect only with a product-specific contract and avoid exposing configuration contents by default

files.name: opaque_core_dump_artifact
files.purpose: opaque crash artifact; record path and size only and do not recursively unpack by default

files.name: opaque_optbmc_artifact
files.purpose: opaque product-specific configuration or state artifact; record path and size only and do not expand backups without explicit authorization

files.name: observed_dump_root_artifact
files.purpose: root-level collection artifact; report path and size without inferring the producer or payload contract

notes.nested_archives: Do not recursively unpack CoreDump, factory backups, configuration archives, or other nested archives by default
notes.unclassified_common_files: Every observed path is covered by either a file-specific definition or an observed-artifact definition. A covered artifact may still have unknown fields or semantics; do not select or interpret it by filename alone unless a maintained contract exists
notes.fallback: If no rule matches or file meaning is unknown, preserve it as an evidence gap and update the catalog only from verified public or user-supplied documentation
notes.language: Prefer adding common Chinese user phrases so problem-driven selection works for teammates
